exercises.name: 90/90 Hamstring
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, one leg extended straight out
• Bend the other hip and knee to 90°, bracing with your hands if needed
• Hold the position, feeling the stretch through the extended leg's hamstring
• Switch legs and repeat

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description:
• Kneel on the floor holding an ab wheel in front of you
• Brace your core
• Roll the wheel forward, extending your torso as far as you can control
• Pull back to the start using your abs, avoiding letting your back sag

exercises.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
exercises.description:
• Start on your hands and knees
• Lift one leg off the floor and reach back to hold that foot or ankle with your hand
• Keep the knee fully flexed, feeling a stretch through the quad and hip flexor
• Hold, then switch legs

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description:
• Sit or stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing you
• Press the dumbbells up while rotating your palms forward
• At the top, arms are extended and palms face away from you
• Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.description:
• Lie face down on a hyperextension bench, hips at the pad, ankles secured
• Cross your arms over your chest or behind your head
• Lower your upper body toward the floor
• Raise back up to parallel (or slightly above), squeezing your glutes and lower back

exercises.name: Back Squat (BB)
exercises.description:
• Rack a barbell across your upper traps
• Feet shoulder-width apart, brace your core
• Squat down, pushing your knees out, until thighs are at least parallel to the floor
• Drive through your whole foot to stand back up

exercises.name: Banded Clamshell
exercises.description:
• Lie on your side, knees bent, a resistance band looped above your knees
• Keep your feet together
• Rotate your top knee upward, opening like a clamshell
• Lower with control, then repeat, then switch sides

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description:
• Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, barbell over your hips
• Feet flat, knees bent
• Drive through your heels to thrust your hips upward until thighs are parallel to the floor
• Squeeze your glutes hard at the top, then lower with control

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.description:
• Sit on the edge of a bench, hands gripping the edge, fingers forward
• Extend your legs out in front, heels on the floor
• Slide your hips off the bench so your arms support your weight
• Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor
• Press back up through your palms to full arm extension

exercises.name: Bench Press (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Lie on a flat bench
• Grip a barbell just outside shoulder width, or hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level
• Lower the weight to your mid-chest, elbows at roughly 45°
• Press back up to lockout

exercises.name: Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral
exercises.description:
• Stand bent at the waist, torso near parallel to the floor, side-on to a low pulley
• Hold the handle with your far hand, arm hanging down
• Raise your arm out to the side until in line with your shoulder, leading with the elbow
• Keep a slight bend in the arm throughout
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Pullover (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Lie perpendicular across a flat bench, only your shoulders supported
• Hold a dumbbell or barbell straight over your chest, slight bend in your arms
• Lower the weight behind your head in an arc, feeling a stretch through your lats and chest
• Pull back over your chest to the start

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
exercises.description:
• Lie flat on the floor, arms at your sides
• Bend your knees to about 75°
• Lift your feet a couple of inches off the floor using your lower abs
• Lower with control and repeat

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (DB/BB/KB)
exercises.description:
• Hinge at the hips with a flat back, holding a barbell, a dumbbell in each hand, or a pair of kettlebells
• Let the weight hang at arm's length
• Row the weight to your lower chest or navel, driving elbows back and retracting shoulder blades
• Lower under control

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, hands behind your head, legs raised with knees bent
• Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg
• Alternate sides in a pedalling motion
• Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.description:
• Set up in a power rack with a box behind you at your target depth
• Rack a barbell on your upper back as in a back squat
• Descend under control until you sit lightly on the box
• Pause briefly without relaxing your brace
• Drive back up through your heels to standing

exercises.name: Bradford/Rocky Presses
exercises.description:
• Sit on a bench with back support, bar racked at shoulder height, pronated grip
• Press the bar up until your arms are extended
• Lower the bar behind your head to touch your upper traps
• Press back up and lower to the front, without fully locking out between reps
• Alternate front-to-back presses for the set

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand a couple of feet in front of a bench, rear foot elevated on it
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, or use bodyweight only
• Lower your back knee toward the floor, front shin staying vertical
• Drive through your front heel to stand back up

exercises.name: Butterfly
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine with your back flat against the pad
• Grip the handles, upper arms parallel to the floor
• Bring your arms together in front of your chest
• Squeeze your pecs, then return with control

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press
exercises.description:
• Set both pulleys to chest height, sit or stand between the towers
• Grip a handle in each hand, elbows bent ~90°, upper arms at about 45° from your torso
• Press the handles forward until your arms are extended
• Squeeze your chest at full extension
• Return with control

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.description:
• Set both cables at shoulder height
• Step forward between the towers, one handle in each hand
• Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion, crossing slightly at the bottom
• Squeeze your chest, then return with control

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description:
• Kneel facing a high cable pulley with a rope attachment
• Hold the rope behind your head
• Crunch your elbows down toward your knees, rounding your spine
• Return with control, keeping tension on your abs throughout

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description:
• Stand facing a low cable pulley
• Grip the handle with an underhand grip, arms extended
• Curl from full extension to full contraction
• Lower with control, keeping tension on the biceps throughout

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.description:
• Set a cable at face height with a rope attachment
• Grip the rope with both hands, arms extended
• Pull the rope toward your face, splitting your hands apart as elbows rise high and wide
• Return with control

exercises.name: Cable Hip Adduction
exercises.description:
• Stand side-on to a low pulley, ankle cuff attached to the leg nearest the pulley
• Cross that leg in front of the other, away from the pulley
• Pull the leg across your body against the resistance
• Return with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.description:
• Attach an ankle strap to a low cable, strap on one ankle
• Brace yourself on the machine
• Kick the strapped leg straight back and up, squeezing the glute at the top
• Return with control, avoiding hip rotation, then switch sides

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description:
• Set a low cable to one side, stand side-on to it
• Grip the handle with the far hand, arm hanging across your body
• Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description:
• Set both pulleys above head height
• Cross your arms, gripping the left pulley with your right hand and the right pulley with your left hand
• Pull your arms out and back in a reverse-fly motion, squeezing your rear delts
• Return with control

exercises.name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.description:
• Attach a rope to a low pulley
• Face away from the machine, rope held overhead in both hands, neutral grip, elbows close to your head
• Extend your arms until straight, splitting the rope ends apart slightly at the top
• Bend your elbows to lower back down behind your head
• Keep elbows fixed throughout

exercises.name: Cable Shoulder Press
exercises.description:
• Set both cables at the bottom of the towers, stand between them
• Grip the cables at shoulder height, palms facing forward
• Press both hands straight overhead until arms are extended
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Cable Shrugs
exercises.description:
• Attach a bar to a low pulley, grip it with hands slightly wider than shoulder width, palms down
• Stand tall, close to the pulley, arms extended holding the bar
• Elevate your shoulders straight up as high as possible
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.description:
• Support yourself on parallel bars, arms locked
• Lean your torso forward
• Lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the floor
• Press back up; the forward lean shifts load to the lower chest

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Incline Row (DB)
exercises.description:
• Lie face down on an incline bench, chest supported
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, arms hanging straight down
• Row both dumbbells up toward your hips, driving elbows back
• Lower with control back to full arm extension

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.description:
• Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart
• Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar
• Squeeze your lats and biceps at the top
• Lower with control back to a full hang

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description:
• Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar shoulder-width or narrower
• Unrack and lower the bar to your lower chest, elbows tucked close to your sides
• Press back up to full extension, focusing on your triceps
• Repeat with control

exercises.name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
exercises.description:
• Sit at a lat pulldown station, thighs secured under the pads
• Grip the bar with hands closer than shoulder width, palms facing away
• Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving elbows down and back
• Squeeze your lats at the bottom
• Let the bar rise with control back to full arm extension

exercises.name: Close-Grip Upright Row (BB)
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell or cable attachment with a narrow, overhand grip
• Stand tall
• Pull the weight straight up to chin height, leading with your elbows
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Cocoons
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, legs straight, arms extended behind your head
• Simultaneously curl your knees toward your chest and your arms/torso forward
• Rotate your pelvis to lift your hips off the floor at the top
• Pause briefly in the tucked position
• Uncurl with control back to the start

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description:
• Sit on a bench, legs apart
• Brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh, dumbbell hanging down
• Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, fully contracting the bicep
• Lower with control; no swinging

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
• Place your hands behind your head, or hold a weight on your chest
• Curl your upper spine off the floor, contracting your abs
• Lower with control, avoiding pulling on your neck

exercises.name: Cuban Press
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging, pronated grip
• Raise your upper arms out to the sides to parallel with the floor (scarecrow position), forearms hanging down
• Externally rotate your shoulders to bring the dumbbells up so forearms point overhead
• Press the dumbbells straight overhead
• Reverse the sequence to return to the start

exercises.name: Curl (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a barbell or a pair of dumbbells at hip height, underhand grip
• Keep your elbows pinned at your sides
• Curl the weight up toward your chest
• Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower with control

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, arms raised toward the ceiling, knees bent at 90°
• Brace your core, keeping your lower back flat on the floor
• Extend one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor
• Return and switch sides

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description:
• Stand with the bar over your mid-foot, grip just outside your legs
• Hinge down, chest up, back flat, brace your core
• Drive the floor away to stand, keeping the bar close to your legs
• Lower with control back to the floor

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Set the bench to a 15–30° decline, secure your legs
• Grip a barbell just outside shoulder width, or hold a dumbbell in each hand
• Lower the weight to your lower chest
• Press back up to full extension

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.description:
• Get into a push-up position, hands together under your chest forming a diamond shape with thumbs and index fingers
• Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back
• Press back up to full extension
• Keep your body in a straight line throughout

exercises.name: Dip Machine
exercises.description:
• Sit securely in the dip machine, select your weight
• Grip the handles, elbows in at your sides, bent at 90°
• Press down until arms are extended
• Return with control

exercises.name: Double Leg Butt Kick
exercises.description:
• Stand with knees slightly bent
• Quickly squat a short distance
• Explosively extend your hips and knees to jump for maximum height
• Land softly and repeat

exercises.name: Drag Curl
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, elbows pulled back and close to your torso
• Curl the bar upward while keeping it dragging in contact with your body
• Keep your elbows traveling backward rather than forward as the bar rises
• Squeeze at the top
• Lower with control, staying in contact with your torso

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.description:
• Lie on a bench, gripping it above your head for support
• Lift your entire body off the bench, supported only at your shoulders
• Lower your body in a straight, rigid line
• Raise back up, keeping your body straight throughout

exercises.name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
exercises.description:
• Lie face down on an incline bench, chest supported
• Let a dumbbell hang in each hand, arms fully extended
• Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders
• Squeeze your biceps at the top
• Lower with control back to full extension

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Flye
exercises.description:
• Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, dumbbell in each hand
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows
• Raise both arms out to the sides, leading with your elbows
• Squeeze your rear delts at the top, then lower with control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Scaption
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, thumbs pointing up
• Raise your arms out in front of you at about 30° from your body (between a front raise and lateral raise)
• Lift to shoulder height
• Pause briefly
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.description:
• Place a block on the floor near a flat bench, sit on the bench
• Place one foot on the block, ball of the foot on the edge, heel hanging off
• Rest a dumbbell on top of that thigh near the knee
• Raise and lower your heel through a full range of motion, then switch legs

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides
• Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
• Bend your knees and hips to squat down, keeping your chest up
• Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor
• Drive through your feet to stand back up

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.description:
• Hold an EZ-curl bar at the angled outer grips, palms facing forward
• Keep your elbows pinned at your sides
• Curl the bar up toward your chest
• Squeeze your biceps at the top
• Lower with control back to full extension

exercises.name: Elbow to Knee
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, hands clasped behind your head
• Cross one leg over, resting that ankle on the opposite bent knee
• Curl your torso, rotating to bring the opposite elbow toward the raised knee
• Pause briefly at the contraction
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Elevated Cable Rows
exercises.description:
• Place a low platform (4–6 inches) on the seat of a cable row machine
• Sit or kneel on the platform, grip the handle
• Row the handle to your torso, driving elbows back and squeezing your back
• Extend back out with control

exercises.name: Elevated Reverse Lunge (BB)
exercises.description:
• Rack a barbell across your upper back
• Stand on a raised platform a few inches off the ground
• Step backward off the platform into a reverse lunge, lowering your rear knee toward the floor
• Push through your front foot to return to the platform

exercises.name: External Rotation
exercises.description:
• Lie on your side holding a light dumbbell, or stand using a cable at waist height
• Keep your elbow fixed at 90°, pinned to your side
• Rotate your forearm upward and outward
• Return with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: External Rotation with Cable
exercises.description:
• Set a cable at elbow height, stand side-on to the machine
• Grip the handle with your far hand, elbow bent 90° and pinned to your side
• Keeping the elbow fixed, rotate your forearm outward away from your body
• Pause at full rotation
• Return with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Finger Curls
exercises.description:
• Sit or stand holding a barbell with both hands, palms facing up, shoulder-width grip
• Let the bar roll down to your fingertips
• Curl your fingers to roll the bar back up into your palms
• Repeat, keeping wrists and forearms otherwise still

exercises.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
exercises.description:
• Lie face up on a bench, hips at the edge, legs extended off the end
• Hold the bench at your sides or tuck your hands under your glutes
• Raise your straight legs up until vertical
• Lower with control without letting your feet touch the floor

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Flye
exercises.description:
• Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows
• Lower your arms out in a wide arc until you feel a deep chest stretch
• Squeeze back up to the top

exercises.name: Floor Press
exercises.description:
• Lie on the floor with a barbell racked at an appropriate height above you
• Grip the bar at shoulder width and pull it off the rack
• Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor
• Pause briefly
• Press back up to full extension

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.description:
• Lie face down on a bench, hips at the edge, holding the front edge with your hands
• Extend your legs straight out behind you, toes pointed
• Squeeze your glutes and raise your legs until level with your hips
• Alternate small up-and-down flutter kicks with straight legs
• Keep your core braced throughout

exercises.name: Front Cable Raise
exercises.description:
• Stand facing away from a low pulley, handle in one hand in front of your thighs
• Keep a slight bend in your elbow
• Raise your arm straight up in front of you to shoulder height
• Pause briefly
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Front Dumbbell Raise
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs
• Keep your torso still, no swinging
• Raise one arm straight up in front of you to shoulder height
• Lower with control
• Alternate arms each rep

exercises.name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
exercises.description:
• Sit on an incline bench set to 30–60°, holding a dumbbell in each hand
• Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing down
• Raise your arms straight in front of you to shoulder height
• Pause briefly at the top
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Front Leg Raises
exercises.description:
• Stand next to a chair or support, holding on with one hand
• Keep the working leg straight
• Swing it forward to hip height, then swing back as far as your flexibility allows
• Repeat, then switch legs

exercises.name: Front Raise (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides
• Keep your torso still, no swinging
• Raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Front Squat (BB)
exercises.description:
• Rack a barbell across your front delts, elbows high
• Feet shoulder-width apart
• Squat down keeping your torso upright
• Drive through your feet to stand back up

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor
• Rest a barbell across your hips if adding load, or keep arms at your sides
• Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees
• Pause at the top, then lower slowly

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.description:
• Set up on a glute-ham developer, feet secured against the footplate, knees just behind the pad
• Start face down with your back arched
• Curl your body upward by flexing your knees and driving your hips forward
• Rise until your body is upright
• Lower with control back to the start

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.description:
• Get on your hands and knees, arms extended, shoulder-width apart
• Keep your core braced and back flat
• Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing the glute at the top
• Avoid rotating your hips or arching your lower back
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description:
• Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically at chest height with both hands
• Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
• Squat deep, pushing your knees out over your toes, keeping torso upright
• Drive through your feet to stand back up

exercises.name: Good Morning (BB)
exercises.description:
• Rack a barbell across your upper back, as in a squat
• Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent and fixed
• Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat, until your torso is near parallel to the floor
• Feel the stretch through your hamstrings
• Drive your hips forward to return to standing

exercises.name: Groiners
exercises.description:
• Start in a push-up position
• Jump both feet forward to land just outside your hands
• Immediately jump back to the push-up position
• Repeat, keeping your head up

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description:
• Position yourself in the machine, feet on the platform, back against the pad
• Release the safety and lower until thighs are parallel
• Press back up through your feet
• Keep your feet forward for quad emphasis throughout

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other
• Keep elbows pinned at your sides
• Curl the weight up, maintaining the neutral grip throughout
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description:
• Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms
• Keep your core braced
• Raise your legs (bent or straight) until parallel to the floor or higher
• Lower with control, avoiding swinging

exercises.name: Hanging Pike
exercises.description:
• Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder width
• Keep your legs together and straight
• Bend your knees to 90° and bring them up
• Continue raising your hips and legs until your body forms a pike
• Lower with control back to a full hang

exercises.name: Hip Abductor Machine
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine with the pads against the outside of your knees
• Keep your upper body stationary
• Push your legs outward against the resistance
• Squeeze at the end range, then return with control

exercises.name: Hip Circles (prone)
exercises.description:
• Get on your hands and knees
• Raise one bent knee off the ground
• Rotate the femur in an arc, tracing a big circle with your knee
• Complete reps, then switch sides

exercises.name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
exercises.description:
• Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the edge
• Have a partner hold your legs down
• Let your upper body hang toward the floor
• Raise your torso using your lower back until in line with your legs
• Lower with control back down

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.description:
• Stand with feet close together, legs straight
• Bend forward and place your hands on the floor
• Walk your hands forward into a plank position
• Walk your feet forward to meet your hands, keeping legs as straight as possible
• Repeat the sequence

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Set the bench to 30–45°
• Lower a barbell to your upper chest, or press dumbbells up from shoulder level
• Allow a slight inward arc at the top
• Press to full extension, then lower with control

exercises.name: Incline Cable Chest Press
exercises.description:
• Set both pulleys to a lower position, sit on an incline bench between the towers
• Grip a handle in each hand, elbows bent ~90°
• Press the handles up and forward until your arms are extended
• Squeeze your upper chest at full extension
• Return with control

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flye
exercises.description:
• Lie on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in
• Keep a slight bend in your elbows
• Lower your arms out in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your upper chest
• Squeeze back up to the top

exercises.name: Incline Inner Biceps Curl
exercises.description:
• Lie back on an incline bench, a dumbbell in each hand hanging at arm's length, palms facing out
• Keep your upper arms still
• Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders
• Lower with control back to full extension

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Medium
exercises.description:
• Stand facing a bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height
• Place your hands on it, shoulder-width apart, and walk your feet back into a plank
• Lower your chest toward the bar, elbows at about 45°
• Press back up to full extension

exercises.name: JM Press
exercises.description:
• Lie on a flat bench, holding a barbell at arm's length with a close grip, elbows in
• Lower the bar toward your neck/chin in a path between a skull crusher and a close-grip bench press
• Keep elbows pointed forward, not flared
• Press back up to full extension
• Repeat with control

exercises.name: Jefferson Squat (BB)
exercises.description:
• Place a loaded barbell on the floor, straddling it with feet apart
• Grip the bar with one hand in front of your body and one hand behind
• Squat down and stand up, keeping the bar close and your torso upright
• Alternate hand position each set to balance both sides

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
exercises.description:
• Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder and press it overhead with one arm, locked out
• Turn your feet roughly 45° away from that arm
• Keeping the kettlebell overhead and eyes on it, hinge sideways at the hips toward your front foot
• Slide your free hand down your leg toward the floor
• Reverse the movement to return to standing

exercises.name: Knee Circles
exercises.description:
• Stand with feet together, hands on your waist
• Bend your knees slightly
• Move your knees in a circular motion
• Breathe normally throughout, then reverse direction

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.description:
• Kneel in front of a high pulley, a straight bar attachment overhead
• Grip the bar with hands about 6 inches apart, palms down
• Extend your arms down until straight, elbows staying high and fixed
• Bend elbows to return with control

exercises.name: Kneeling High Pulley Row
exercises.description:
• Set a pulley above head height, attach a rope
• Kneel a couple of feet away, arms extended holding the rope
• Pull the rope down and back by flexing your elbows, driving them toward your hips
• Squeeze your back at the bottom
• Extend your arms back out with control

exercises.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
exercises.description:
• Load one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment or a corner
• Stand sideways to it, gripping the free end with the near hand
• Raise the bar out to the side in an arc up to shoulder height
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.description:
• Load one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment or a corner
• Hold the free end at shoulder height with both hands
• Press it up and forward in an arcing path
• Lower with control back to the start

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.description:
• Lie face down in the machine, or sit in a seated version, pad against your lower legs
• Curl your legs toward your glutes against the resistance
• Squeeze your hamstrings at full contraction
• Lower slowly back to the start

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, pad against your lower shins
• Extend your legs fully against the resistance
• Squeeze your quads at the top
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Leg Lift
exercises.description:
• Stand tall, holding a stable support for balance
• Keep your standing leg slightly bent
• Lift the other leg straight back behind you, squeezing the glute
• Keep your torso upright, avoid leaning forward
• Lower with control, then switch legs

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, feet at shoulder width on the platform
• Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees are at 90°
• Press back up to near-lockout, without locking your knees fully
• Adjust foot placement to shift emphasis between quads and hamstrings

exercises.name: Leverage Chest Press
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, seat adjusted so handles start near the bottom or middle of your chest
• Keep your chest and head up, shoulder blades retracted
• Press the handles forward until arms are extended
• Return with control

exercises.name: Leverage Decline Chest Press
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine with the seat adjusted so handles start at the bottom of your chest
• Keep your chest up and shoulder blades retracted
• Press the handles forward and up until your arms are extended
• Squeeze your lower chest
• Return with control

exercises.name: Leverage High Row
exercises.description:
• Adjust the seat so you can reach the handles above you, knee pad locked in
• Grip the handles with a pronated grip
• Pull the handles down toward your torso, driving elbows back
• Squeeze your back at the bottom
• Extend your arms back up with control

exercises.name: Leverage Incline Chest Press
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine with handles starting near the top of your chest
• Keep your chest up and shoulder blades retracted
• Press the handles forward and up until your arms are extended
• Squeeze your upper chest
• Return with control

exercises.name: Leverage Shoulder Press
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, seat adjusted so handles start near your shoulders
• Grip the handles with a pronated grip, chest and head up
• Press the handles straight overhead until your arms are extended
• Pause briefly
• Lower with control back to the start

exercises.name: Lower Back Curl
exercises.description:
• Lie face down, arms out to your sides
• Keep your legs and hips on the floor
• Using only your lower back muscles, lift your chest off the floor
• Don't push with your arms
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Lunge (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Rack a barbell on your back, or hold a dumbbell in each hand
• Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor
• Keep your torso upright
• Push back to the starting position, then repeat, alternating legs

exercises.name: Lying Crossover
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, legs extended, a partner kneeling beside you
• Cross one leg over your body, bent knee reaching toward the floor on the opposite side
• Partner holds your opposite shoulder down and controls the crossed leg for a stretch
• Hold briefly
• Return and switch sides

exercises.name: Lying Glute
exercises.description:
• Lie on your back, partner kneeling beside you
• Raise one leg, rotating it so the foot crosses over the opposite hip, lower leg perpendicular to your body
• Partner holds your knee and ankle to apply a stretch
• Hold briefly
• Return and switch sides

exercises.name: Lying Prone Quadriceps
exercises.description:
• Lie face down, partner kneeling beside you
• Bend one knee, raising that foot toward your glutes
• Partner holds your knee and ankle, gently deepening the stretch
• Hold briefly
• Return and switch legs

exercises.name: Lying Rear Delt Raise (DB)
exercises.description:
• Lie face-down on a flat or slightly inclined bench, dumbbell in each hand, neutral grip, arms extended, elbows slightly bent
• Keep your chest pressed into the bench
• Raise your arms out to the sides until in line with your shoulders
• Squeeze your rear delts, then lower with control

exercises.name: Machine Bicep Curl
exercises.description:
• Adjust the seat height, select your weight
• Rest your upper arms against the pads, grip the handles
• Flex your elbows, pulling your lower arms toward your upper arms
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder (Military) Press
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, select your weight
• Grip the handles at your sides, elbows bent and in line with your torso
• Press the handles overhead until arms are extended
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Machine Triceps Extension
exercises.description:
• Adjust the seat height, select your weight
• Rest your upper arms against the pads, grip the handles
• Extend your elbows, pulling your lower arms away from your upper arms
• Return with control

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.description:
• Kneel upright with your feet anchored
• Keeping your hips extended, lower your torso slowly toward the floor, resisting with your hamstrings
• Go as far down as you can control, using your hands to push up if needed
• Return to upright, or push up from the floor and reset

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
exercises.description:
• Grip a barbell wider than shoulder width, pronated grip
• Press the bar overhead, arms locked out, bar balanced over your midfoot
• Keeping the bar overhead throughout, squat down with feet wider than shoulder width
• Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor
• Drive up through your heels back to standing, bar staying overhead

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms fully extended
• Keep your elbows close to your head
• Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows
• Extend back up to full extension

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.description:
• Stand sideways to a cable machine, handle held at chest height with both hands
• Step away from the machine to create tension
• Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the cable's rotational pull
• Return with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, back flat against the pad
• Rest your forearms on the pads at chest height
• Bring the pads together in front of your chest
• Squeeze your pecs at the peak, then return with control

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description:
• Get into a forearm plank position, elbows under shoulders
• Extend your legs behind you, weight on your toes
• Brace your core and glutes, keeping a straight line from head to heel
• Hold for time, avoiding letting your hips sag or pike

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad, underhand grip on a barbell or dumbbells
• Start from full arm extension
• Curl the weight up, focusing on the peak contraction
• Lower slowly, stopping just short of full hyperextension

exercises.name: Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description:
• Rest your upper arms on a preacher bench, a dumbbell in each hand, neutral grip
• Start with arms extended, biceps fully stretched
• Curl both dumbbells up while maintaining the neutral grip
• Lower slowly with control

exercises.name: Pull Through
exercises.description:
• Straddle a low pulley, cable running between your legs, rope or handle attached
• Face away from the machine, feet wide
• Hinge at the hips, reaching through your legs as far as comfortable, soft knees
• Drive your hips forward to stand, squeezing your glutes at the top
• Repeat with control

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description:
• Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, wider than shoulder width
• Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar
• Squeeze your lats at the top
• Lower back to a full hang with control

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description:
• Start in a high plank, hands just outside shoulder width
• Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45°
• Press back up to full arm extension
• Keep your body in a straight line throughout

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
exercises.description:
• Get into a push-up position with your toes on top of a bench or box
• Hands slightly wider than shoulder width
• Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45°
• Press back up to full extension
• Keep your body in a straight line throughout

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.description:
• Set the safety pins in a rack at knee height, barbell resting on them
• Grip the bar as in a deadlift
• Pull the bar up to full lockout, focusing on your upper back and traps
• Lower with control back to the pins

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart
• Keep your elbows pinned at your sides
• Curl the bar up, keeping the overhand position throughout
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell with a supinated (underhand) grip
• Hinge forward at the hips, knees slightly bent, back flat, torso near parallel to floor
• Row the bar to your lower ribcage, elbows staying close to your body
• Squeeze your back at the top
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
exercises.description:
• Set a bar attachment on a high pulley
• Grip it with palms facing up, shoulder width
• Keeping elbows pinned at your sides, push the bar down until your arms are extended
• Squeeze your triceps at the bottom
• Let the bar rise back up with control

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.description:
• Lie face down on a bench, hips at the edge, legs hanging off
• Grip the bench or handles for support
• Raise your legs behind you using your glutes and hamstrings until parallel to the floor
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand tall, holding a dumbbell in each hand if adding load
• Step backward into a lunge, lowering your rear knee toward the floor
• Push through your front foot to return to standing
• Repeat, alternating legs

exercises.name: Reverse Machine Flyes
exercises.description:
• Sit facing into the machine, handles set to the rear, seat adjusted so handles are at shoulder height
• Grip the handles with palms facing inward
• Pull your arms back and apart in a semicircular motion, squeezing your rear delts and upper back
• Pause at full contraction
• Return with control

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.description:
• Sit facing into the machine, arms extended forward, holding the handles
• Keep your chest against the pad
• Drive both arms back and apart in a reverse hugging motion
• Squeeze your rear delts and rhomboids, then return with control

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell at hip height, standing tall, soft bend in your knees
• Hinge at the hips, pushing them back
• Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch
• Drive your hips forward to return to standing

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description:
• Sit on the floor, knees bent, torso leaned back slightly, feet lifted or planted
• Hold a weight, or clasp your hands, in front of your chest
• Rotate your torso to touch down on one side
• Rotate through center to the other side, pausing briefly each time

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Military Press
exercises.description:
• Sit on a bench with back support, bar behind your head at the base of your neck (spotter hands it to you)
• Grip the bar wider than shoulder width, pronated grip
• Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended
• Lower slowly back down behind your head
• Repeat with control

exercises.name: Seated Barbell Twist
exercises.description:
• Sit at the end of a flat bench, feet flat and shoulder-width apart
• Rest a barbell across your thighs, gripping it wider than shoulder width
• Rotate your torso to one side as far as comfortable, then back through center to the other side
• Keep your hips facing forward throughout
• Movement stays in the torso, not the hips

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
exercises.description:
• Sit at the end of a bench, feet together, a dumbbell in each hand resting behind your calves
• Bend forward at the hips, torso near your thighs
• Raise both arms out to the sides, squeezing your rear delts
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.description:
• Sit at the end of a bench, knees bent, torso bent forward until near parallel to floor
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand behind you, neutral grip, elbows bent
• Extend your arms straight back, keeping upper arms still
• Squeeze your triceps at full extension
• Bend elbows to lower back with control

exercises.name: Seated Biceps
exercises.description:
• Sit on the floor, knees bent, partner standing behind you
• Extend your arms straight behind you, palms facing each other, partner holding your wrists
• Attempt to flex your elbows, curling your hands toward you against the partner's resistance
• Hold briefly at peak contraction
• Return to extension and repeat

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.description:
• Sit in the machine, balls of your feet on the platform, pad on your lower thighs
• Release the safety
• Raise your heels as high as possible
• Lower with control until you feel a deep stretch

exercises.name: Seated Front Deltoid
exercises.description:
• Sit upright on the floor, legs bent, partner standing behind you
• Extend your arms straight out to your sides, palms facing down, partner holding your wrists
• Attempt to move your arms as far behind you as possible against the partner's resistance
• Hold briefly
• Return to the start and repeat

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Sit on a bench with back support, holding a barbell or a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height
• Brace your core
• Press the weight overhead until arms are fully extended
• Lower with control back to shoulder height

exercises.name: Seated Triceps Press
exercises.description:
• Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell overhead with both hands
• Keep your upper arms close to your head, elbows pointed forward
• Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows
• Pause at full stretch
• Extend back up to full arm extension

exercises.name: Shrug (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs, or a dumbbell in each hand at your sides
• Keep your arms fully extended
• Elevate your shoulders as high as possible
• Hold the contraction briefly, then lower with control

exercises.name: Side Bend (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Stand up straight holding a dumbbell in one hand, or a barbell across your upper back
• Keep your back straight and head up
• Bend at the waist to one side as far as comfortable
• Return to standing; complete all reps on one side before switching

exercises.name: Side Jackknife
exercises.description:
• Lie on your side, legs stacked and extended, supporting your upper body on one forearm
• Extend your top arm straight overhead in line with your body
• Simultaneously lift your legs and bring your top elbow down to meet them, folding at the waist
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description:
• Lie on your side, propped up on one forearm, feet stacked
• Lift your hips off the ground
• Maintain a straight line from head to feet
• Hold for time, then switch sides

exercises.name: Side Split Squat (BB)
exercises.description:
• Rack a barbell across your upper back
• Stand with feet very wide, toes of the working leg turned slightly out
• Shift your weight to that side and bend that knee deeply, keeping the other leg straight
• Lower until your hamstring nears your calf
• Drive back up through the bent leg, then repeat on the other side

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description:
• Plant one knee and hand on a bench for support, dumbbell in the other hand
• Keep your torso parallel to the floor, back flat
• Row the dumbbell toward your hip, driving your elbow back
• Lower with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift (KB)
exercises.description:
• Hold a kettlebell by the handle in one hand
• Stand on the same-side leg, knee slightly bent
• Hinge at the hip, extending your free leg behind you for balance, lowering the kettlebell toward the floor
• Drive your hip forward to return to standing, then switch sides

exercises.name: Skull Crusher (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Lie on a bench holding a barbell, EZ-bar, or a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, elbows tucked in
• Keep your upper arms vertical and stationary
• Bend only at the elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead
• Press back to full extension

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.description:
• Set a flat bench under the Smith machine bar
• Lie down with the bar positioned over your chest at an appropriate height
• Grip the bar wider than shoulder width, pronated grip
• Unrack and lower the bar to your mid-chest
• Press back up to full extension

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
exercises.description:
• Set a block or plate under the balls of your feet on the Smith machine platform
• Rack the bar across your upper back
• Lower your heels as far as possible below the block
• Rise up onto your toes as high as you can, then lower with control

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.description:
• Set the bar to shoulder height, step under it, rest it across your upper back
• Unrack and step your feet forward slightly, shoulder-width apart
• Squat down until thighs are at least parallel to the floor
• Drive through your feet to stand back up
• Re-rack the bar at the end of the set

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.description:
• Set up on the front side of a preacher bench, chest and stomach against the pad, arms hanging down
• Hold a barbell or EZ-bar with an underhand grip
• Curl the bar up toward your chin
• Squeeze your biceps at the top
• Lower with control back to full extension

exercises.name: Standing Cable Lift
exercises.description:
• Set a pulley to its lowest position, attach a handle
• Stand side-on to the machine, arm's length away, grip the handle with your far hand
• Rotate and lift diagonally, pulling the handle up and across your body to above your opposite shoulder
• Pivot your back foot as you rotate
• Return with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Standing Cable Wood Chop
exercises.description:
• Set a pulley to its highest position, attach a handle
• Stand side-on to the machine, arm's length away, grip the handle with your far hand
• Rotate and pull diagonally downward across your body toward your opposite hip
• Pivot your back foot as you rotate
• Return with control, then switch sides

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand with the balls of your feet on an elevated surface, a dumbbell in each hand if adding resistance
• Lower your heels as far as possible
• Rise up onto your toes as high as you can
• Pause and squeeze at the top, then lower slowly

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
exercises.description:
• Stand on one leg, holding a vertical support for balance
• Raise the other knee to 90°
• Rotate that hip in a circular motion
• Complete reps, then switch legs and/or direction

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Press (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a barbell racked at shoulder height, or a dumbbell in each hand
• Brace your core to avoid leaning back
• Press the weight overhead until arms are extended
• Lower with control back to shoulder height

exercises.name: Step-Up (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand in front of a box or bench, a dumbbell in each hand if adding load
• Place one foot fully on the box
• Drive through that heel to bring your whole body up onto the box
• Step back down with control, then repeat

exercises.name: Step-up with Knee Raise
exercises.description:
• Stand facing a box or bench, feet together
• Step up, placing one foot on top of the box
• Extend through the hip and knee to stand fully on the box
• Drive your opposite knee up toward your chest at the top
• Step back down with control, then switch legs

exercises.name: Stiff-Legged Deadlift (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell or a dumbbell in each hand, torso straight, feet shoulder-width or narrower, knees slightly bent
• Hinge at the hips, keeping the weight close to your legs
• Lower until you feel a deep hamstring stretch
• Drive your hips forward to return to standing

exercises.name: Stomach Vacuum
exercises.description:
• Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on your hips
• Inhale fully
• Exhale completely, drawing your stomach in as far as possible
• Hold the contracted position, continuing to breathe shallowly
• Release and repeat

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.description:
• Place a dumbbell upright on one end of a flat bench
• Lie perpendicular across the bench, only your shoulders supported, hips below the bench
• Hold the dumbbell straight above your chest with both hands, arms locked
• Lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch through your lats
• Pull back over your chest, keeping your arms straight throughout

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.description:
• Stand facing a high cable pulley, arms extended overhead, gripping a straight bar
• Keep your arms straight throughout
• Pull the bar down to your thighs using only shoulder extension
• Return with control, keeping bicep involvement minimal

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description:
• Take a wide stance, toes pointed out, gripping the bar inside your legs
• Hinge down, keeping your back flat and chest up
• Drive the floor away to stand
• Lower with control back to the floor

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Take a wide stance, toes turned out
• Hold a barbell across your back, or a single dumbbell/kettlebell at the base with both hands in front of you
• Squat down, tracking your knees over your toes, chest tall
• Drive through your feet to stand back up

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description:
• Lie face down, arms fully extended in front of you
• Simultaneously raise your arms, chest, and legs off the floor
• Squeeze your lower back and glutes at the top
• Hold briefly
• Lower with control

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.description:
• Straddle the bar, gripping the handle with a neutral grip
• Hinge forward, keeping your back flat
• Row the weight up to your lower chest
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Tate Press
exercises.description:
• Lie on a flat bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other
• Keep elbows flared out to the sides, upper arms roughly perpendicular to your torso
• Lower the dumbbells by bending your elbows until they nearly touch your chest
• Keep elbows high and stationary throughout
• Press back up to full extension

exercises.name: Thigh Adductor
exercises.description:
• Sit in the adductor machine, legs positioned on the pads
• Grip the handles, upper body stationary
• Press your legs together against the resistance
• Squeeze your inner thighs at the end range
• Return with control to the start

exercises.name: Tricep Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.description:
• Hold a dumbbell in each hand, knees slightly bent, hinge forward at the hips until torso is near parallel to floor
• Keep upper arms close to your torso and parallel to the floor
• Extend your forearms straight back until arms are fully extended
• Squeeze your triceps at the top
• Bend elbows to return with control

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.description:
• Stand at a cable station, bar or rope attachment at head height
• Keep your elbows pinned at your sides
• Press the weight straight down until arms are fully extended
• Let it rise back up with control

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.description:
• Support yourself on parallel bars, arms locked, torso upright
• Keep your elbows close to your body
• Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor
• Press back up to full extension

exercises.name: Underhand Cable Pulldowns
exercises.description:
• Sit at a lat pulldown station, thighs secured under the pads
• Grip a wide bar with an underhand (supinated) grip
• Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving elbows down and back
• Squeeze your lats at the bottom
• Let the bar rise with control back to full arm extension

exercises.name: Upright Cable Row
exercises.description:
• Attach a straight bar to a low pulley
• Grip the bar with hands slightly less than shoulder width, pronated grip, bar resting on your thighs
• Pull the bar straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows
• Elbows rise above your wrists
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Upright Row (DB)
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, pronated grip slightly narrower than shoulder width
• Keep your back straight
• Pull the dumbbells straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows
• Elbows rise above your wrists
• Lower with control

exercises.name: V-Bar Pulldown
exercises.description:
• Sit at a lat pulldown station, thighs secured under the pads
• Grip a V-bar attachment with a neutral grip
• Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving elbows down and back
• Let it rise with control back to full arm extension

exercises.name: V-Bar Pullup
exercises.description:
• Attach a V-bar to a pull-up bar, or use a station with neutral-grip handles
• Hang with palms facing each other
• Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar
• Squeeze your lats at the top
• Lower with control back to a full hang

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description:
• Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor, with or without holding dumbbells or a barbell
• Drive off your front foot and step forward with your rear foot into the next lunge
• Keep your torso upright throughout
• Continue alternating legs as you travel forward

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description:
• Lie on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor
• Grip the bar with a wide, pronated grip, about 3 inches wider than shoulder width per hand
• Unrack and lower the bar to your chest
• Press back up to full extension
• Keep wrists stacked over elbows throughout

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Bent-Over Row (BB)
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell with a wide, overhand grip
• Hinge forward at the hips, knees slightly bent, torso near parallel to floor
• Let the bar hang at arm's length
• Row the bar to your lower chest, driving elbows out and back
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck
exercises.description:
• Sit at a lat pulldown station, thighs secured under the pads
• Grip a wide bar with a pronated (palms-forward) grip
• Pull the bar down behind your head to your upper traps
• Squeeze your lats at the bottom
• Let the bar rise with control back to full arm extension

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up
exercises.description:
• Grip a pull-up bar with a wide, pronated grip
• Lean your torso and head forward so an imaginary line runs from the bar to the back of your neck
• Pull yourself up until the bar reaches behind your neck/upper traps
• Squeeze your back at the top
• Lower with control back to a full hang

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Upright Row (BB)
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell with a wide, overhand grip
• Stand tall
• Pull the bar straight up to chin height, leading with your elbows flaring out to the sides
• Lower with control

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (DB/BB)
exercises.description:
• Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms up, holding a barbell or dumbbells
• Let the weight roll down toward your fingers
• Curl your wrists upward as far as possible
• Lower slowly with control

exercises.name: Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar
exercises.description:
• Hold a barbell with both hands, palms facing down, shoulder-width apart
• Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width
• Alternately roll your wrists, extending one hand up and the other down, as if rolling up a newspaper
• Keep your forearms still — movement stays at the wrist
• Continue alternating for the set

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
exercises.description:
• Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length, palms facing each other, elbows close to your torso
• Curl the dumbbells up with palms facing up, as in a normal curl
• At the top, rotate your wrists so palms face down
• Lower with the reverse (pronated) grip, then rotate back to start
